fields.layout: layout family id from SKILL.md Layer 2
fields.mode: scene/container category for model composition; not a script placement command
fields.size: intrinsic pixel size of the shipped asset
fields.light: observed key light direction to guide image-model integration
fields.safe: [x, y, w, h] approximate available region; inspect the actual image and preserve readable scale and whitespace
fields.capacity: [min, max] suggested composition range, not a tool input limit or mandatory minimum
fields.hang_line: mode=line only, normalised y of the cord
fields.sag: mode=line only, extra droop at the centre
fields.presets: legacy optional layout hints; empty entries provide no validated plan
